levels.title: Support levels
levels.description: What the providing teams promise: hours, one first-response time, a note and the SLA document. Data products, services and applications pick one. Steward documents a level, it does not measure it; response times per priority belong to the ticket system. Criticality is separate: it says how bad an outage is.
levels.slaUrlHint: A web address starting with https://
levels.removeInUse_one: {{count}} item uses this level. Choose the level it gets instead, or leave it without one.
levels.removeInUse_other: {{count}} items use this level. Choose the level they get instead, or leave them without one.
levels.readOnly: Only administrators change the support levels.
